careers.title: Full Stack Developer
careers.description: Builds both client-facing frontend interfaces and server-side backend logic, database integrations, and web infrastructure.
careers.education_expectations: B.Tech/B.E./B.Sc in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent bootcamps

careers.title: Backend Developer
careers.description: Architects server logic, REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, database schemas, and cloud deployment pipelines.
careers.education_expectations: B.Tech/B.E. in CS, IT, Software Engineering

careers.title: Frontend Developer
careers.description: Designs and builds accessible, high-performance visual user interfaces and single page web applications.
careers.education_expectations: B.Tech, BCA, B.Sc CS, or Design background

careers.title: Data Analyst
careers.description: Transforms complex relational datasets into actionable business insights, visual dashboards, and strategic reports.
careers.education_expectations: Degree in CS, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or Business

careers.title: Machine Learning Engineer
careers.description: Designs, trains, evaluates, and deploys predictive machine learning models and AI pipelines into production systems.
careers.education_expectations: B.Tech/M.Tech in CS, Data Science, AI, or Math

careers.title: DevOps Engineer
careers.description: Automates software delivery, manages cloud infrastructure, container orchestration, and CI/CD pipelines.
careers.education_expectations: B.Tech in CS/IT or Systems Engineering background

careers.title: UI/UX Designer
careers.description: Conducts user research, crafts wireframes, designs polished user interfaces, and prototypes interactive digital experiences.
careers.education_expectations: Degree in Design, Fine Arts, HCI, or CS

careers.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
careers.description: Executes multi-channel marketing campaigns, search engine optimization (SEO), social media marketing, and growth analytics.
careers.education_expectations: Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or Humanities
